rows.label: tlk45420141_02_tlk0001
rows.name:
To think the murals here were related
to the ancient Nopon.

rows.label: tlk45420141_02_tlk0002
rows.name:
Hassane told me the water once reached
all the way up to the height of those
murals.

rows.label: tlk45420141_02_tlk0003
rows.name:
Over the years, the place drained
out, and now at the bottom of
what used to be a lake...

rows.label: tlk45420141_02_tlk0004
rows.name:
And now the Hræsvelgr Mercenaries are
there instead.

rows.label: tlk45420141_02_tlk0005
rows.name:
Looks like Alst still has plenty of
mysteries left.

rows.label: tlk45420141_02_tlk0006
rows.name:
I think I'm going to set out wandering
again soon. I want to find more places
like this one, brimming with mystery!
